title: service-automation: RESUME_CHILD_PENDING's no-record refusal names only two runs, so an intermediate subflow run stays parked after the operator follows the remedy
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ① delta contract review of PR #28176 (#27971, ruling A 6523833308), should-fix S3 + S4 (record 6527998437). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: an operator resuming a batch (`map`) run whose item run is gone with no `cancelled` history, when the map sits more than one `subflow:` link below the run they resumed (OUTER → MID → MAP; `MAX_SUSPENSION_CHAIN_DEPTH` is 32).
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

`continuePastCancelledMapItem` refuses with 409 `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` and ends the message with the remedy "To end the batch, cancel run 'MAP_RUN'", plus "and run 'OUTER', which waits on it" when nested. It names `link.runId` and the resumed `runId` only. Cancellation never cascades, so with an intermediate run between them that run stays parked after the operator cancels both named runs.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

- S3: name every run in the suspension chain in the remedy (or say "and the runs waiting on it"). Message text only; the code, status and contract text are unchanged.
- S4: pin the nested remedy suffix (today only the two-level map-run name is pinned, `map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts` L183/L200), including a three-level chain.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`, `subflow` + cancel, map + chain: none. **New.**

Links back: #27971, PR #28176
